answer.reason: The verses tell two things that happened to or through him: Israel was sold into his hand and served him, and he was delivered into Othniel's hand and defeated.

clauses.english: held Israel in servitude for eight years, the LORD having sold them into his hand
clauses.quote: he sold them into the hand of Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia

clauses.english: was delivered by the LORD into the hand of Othniel and defeated
clauses.quote: the LORD delivered Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand
